changes: Added to notes that Bendall describes the manuscript only as 'modern', with no date.

notes: The colophon names no people, date or place. Bendall describes the manuscript only as 'modern' (coarse brown paper, 4 leaves). In the ending, 'śrīdajasavakāyastha' is a corruption of 'śrīvajrasattvakāyastha', compare 'namaḥ śrīvajrasavāya' at the start. It refers to Vajrasattva and does not name a kāyastha scribe. Text title: Tathāgatavyāptaśata (Bendall marks it with '?').
